statement: For n>=2 and an n by n matrix B of independent uniform {-1,+1} entries, P(s_min(B)=0)>=2^(1-n).
proof: Condition on the first row r. The independent second row is uniform on 2^n sign vectors. Exactly r and -r are proportional to r. Thus P(row2=+/-row1)=2/2^n. This event forces a row dependence and hence s_min(B)=0.
remaining_gap: This lower bound provides no upper-tail estimate or solution of C0029.
